org: Computational Engineering & Robotics Lab (CERLAB), Carnegie Mellon University
bullets: Formulated engineering-drawing understanding as a joint semantic and structural learning problem, predicting progressive graph cuts that hierarchically partition drawings into connected functional components.

Integrated node semantic predictions with learned geometric embeddings to improve semantics-consistent structural decomposition of engineering shape graphs; benchmarked GNN variants including GraphSAGE and GATv2.

Built end-to-end pipelines for graph-based CAD understanding spanning preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, evaluation, and custom debugging and performance-analysis tooling on a production engineering-drawing corpus.
